description: An overhead hanging isometric exercise that decompresses the spine, stretches lat fibers, and builds foundational grip endurance.
setup: Reach up and grip an overhead pull up bar with an overhand (pronated) grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
steps: Step off the bench or ground with feet clear of the floor.
Allow full body weight to hang passively from the bar, letting shoulders elevate naturally toward ears.
Maintain relaxed belly breathing and steady grip without swinging for assigned duration.
cues: Wrap thumbs completely around the bar for secure grip
Breathe slowly and allow gravity to lengthen your spine

mistakes.fix: Cross ankles and gently engage lower abs to keep body motionless
Let head hang neutrally between arms and relax neck

rep_standard: Feet completely off ground with arms fully extended for the unbroken target duration
